artworks.title: "Feed Not Things That Have Sharp Claws" [fol. 38 recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: The image shows a figure in a lion's den feeding or battling the lions. The setting is a hexagonal arena with the central figure, covered with a red hood and a sleeveless garment, holding a piece of meat towards a pack of lions. One lion reaches towards the figure with an open mouth, while others surround the figure in a dynamic stance. The walls of the enclosure have architectural designs, with a barred door or window at the lower section, and trees with green foliage outside. The artwork features detailed lines and muted earth tones, resembling medieval manuscript illuminations.

artworks.title: "Speak Not Against the Sun" and "Do Not Make Water Facing the Sun" [fol. 39 recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor and stylus on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Andrea Woodner

artworks.title: The Calumny of Apelles [fol. 6 recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor and stylus on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: The image depicts several figures within a structured setting. The focus is on a seated individual on a throne-like chair, exhibiting full body length in a seated position. There are multiple figures surrounding this central person, with varied body parts shown, several on bent knees or standing, directed towards the seated figure. The seated person has long hair, possibly depicted with a crown or headdress, and is wearing a blue robe with red footwear, holding an orb. Around them are figures with different facial features and hair color; some of them exhibit head coverings or hairstyles that suggest medieval or religious attire. These individuals wear robes in a variety of colors, including red, blue, orange, and green, many of which are intricately patterned or textured. One of the figures holds a long staff. The setting appears indoors, with an arched alcove resembling a decorative niche in the background, flanked by columns, and a mosaic pattern. Behind, a fruit-bearing tree emerges, adding verdant contrast to the scene. The flooring consists of a blue tiled pattern defining the area of the scene.

artworks.title: "You Are Shooting at Heaven" [fol. 9 recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a low horizon line, featuring a church, lush foliage, rolling hills, and a central figure of an archer with scattered arrows. The artwork has detailed linework in a monochromatic color palette of brown tones, resembling an ink or pen-and-ink drawing. The sky above the landscape includes stylized clouds, stars, a sun with rays, and a half-moon with a face.

artworks.title: The Statue of Opportunity, a Passer-by, and Remorse [fol. 8r]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythical scene featuring figures and structures. The image shows a figure standing on a winged platform on top of a mechanical wheel, holding symbolic items like a crescent moon and an armillary sphere. The wheel is mounted on a spire-like column, and below, another figure in traditional attire gestures upwards. To the right, a tower with a person peeking through an arched window is depicted. Latin text encircles the scene. The drawing style is similar to early manuscript illustrations with detailed line work.

artworks.title: The Statue of Opportunity and the Passer-by [fol. 8 recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure standing in front of a castle-like structure with a winged figure on top. The image shows a building resembling a castle with two cylindrical towers topped with flags and a pointed roof in the center. The entrance is an arched doorway, and the front facade features decorative architectural elements. In the foreground, a smaller figure appears to be looking up at the structure, holding a staff or a long object. Above the building, a winged person stands on a platform, holding a globe and another spherical object. The drawing includes text around the central image, which seems to be written in a stylized medieval script. The background is plain, with no additional elements, emphasizing the figures and the structure.

artworks.title: Allegory of the Life of a Scholar in a Rich Household [fol. 3 verso / 4 recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a medieval allegorical scene. The image shows a group of figures within a walled enclosure, looking upwards toward an emblem with a seated figure holding symbols of authority. Below the platform, there are skeletal figures and others with disturbing features. The composition includes detailed architecture and flowing garments, with expressive postures and gestures. The entire scene is etched with fine lines, creating an intricate visual narrative.

artworks.title: "Obliterate the Trace of the Pot in the Ashes" [fol. 32 verso / 33 recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor, heightened with gold on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: This is a painting of an allegorical scene in the style of a Renaissance artist. It is rich in detail, with figures representing various virtues and vices. The scene is divided into sections, with each figure holding a banner inscribed with Latin text. On the left side is a crucifixion scene with figures labeled as virtues such as "Oblivio," "Charitas," and "Vindicta." The right side features figures symbolizing vices or traits like “Crudelitas,” “Voluptas,” and “Cupiditas.” In the center, there is an enthroned figure with a banner reading "Principis Clementis," possibly symbolizing clemency or justice. A flaming central figure holds a shield-like item. The overall composition is reminiscent of manuscript illustrations portraying moral lessons or religious stories through allegorical figures.

artworks.title: "Do Not Turn Back When You Arrive at the End" [fol. 26 verso / 27 recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor on two joined sheets of  laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an allegorical medieval theme. The artwork depicts a scene filled with symbolism. On the left side, a house labeled "Domus Hominis Prudentis" (House of the Wise Man) is shown, with figures labeled as "Cupiditas Vitæ," "Medicus," "Pharmacopoia," and "Ratio." The right side features mythical figures such as "Vir," "Prudes," and "Finis Vitæ." This side includes a mythical creature, a somber figure in a chariot, a figure labeled "Saturnus," and an armored knight labeled "Mars."

artworks.title: Personification of Friendship (Amicitia) [fol. 2 recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: The image shows a young woman standing with a slight lean to her right. She has long, flowing light-colored hair, wearing red and beige robes with her chest partially exposed, touching an injury on her chest. She wears a headband with a central element across her forehead, and is barefoot on a plain, off-white parchment background with faint handwritten text.

artworks.title: "Do Not Make Water on Clippings from Nails or Hair" [fol. 30 recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: The image shows two figures against a plain background. On the left, a person is kneeling and presenting a large chalice. This person has a youthful face, curly hair, and wears a robe. On the right, another person is leaning forward toward the chalice. This person has a bearded face, long hair, and wears an elaborate robe. A stream of red flows from the chalice towards their mouth.

artworks.title: Un Abri (A Shelter)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on chine collé
artworks.description: The image is a monochromatic illustration viewed from a slightly elevated angle, focusing on a dense thicket of foliage forming a natural shelter. There is no clear horizon visible, as the scene centers around the protective cluster of leaves. The brushstrokes are detailed, with fine lines and cross-hatching used to convey texture and depth within the leaves and branches. A bird is perched in the middle of the composition, partially obscured by dark shadows from the foliage. The color palette is limited to shades of gray and black, creating a dramatic visual impact. Lighter shades in the distance suggest the outer canopy edges, while darker forms closer to us create a sense of seclusion.

artworks.title: Les Ours (The Bears)
artworks.medium: etching in black on chine collé
artworks.description: This image shows a black and white etching of two young bears climbing and resting on a tall tree trunk. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, as if from a nearby vantage point on the ground. The horizon line is implied in the upper middle part of the image where the tree canopy thins. The etching is detailed with precise lines creating the texture of the bears' fur and the tree's surface, as well as the surrounding foliage. The vegetation close to us is highly detailed, with intricate lines and shading, while in the distance, smaller trees and hints of clouds suggest a transition into the background where details are softer. The grayscale palette uses contrast to distinguish between the bears and the tree against the foliage and sky.

artworks.title: La Lutte de Jacob (Jacob Wrestling with the Angel)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.description: This print depicts two male figures engaged in physical struggle. The man on the left has two long wings that stretch out to either side. He faces us, and has brown hair that flows around his face, a straight nose, and full lips in a neutral expression. He is looking down at the other man, with one arm around the other man's neck and one leg wrapped around his leg. The other man is on the right and slightly in front of the winged man. He has shorter dark hair, and most of his face is in shadow, facing the left. He has both arms tightly wrapped around the winged man's waist, and his legs are braced firmly on the ground.  He appears to have a torn, ragged cloth partially wrapped around his waist, while the winged man is nude. The background is dark and filled with dense cross-hatching. There is a small white star in the sky above head of the winged man.

artworks.title: Fidès Devriès
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a detailed sketch showing the head and shoulders of a woman in profile, facing to the left. She is positioned with her head slightly turned, showing her profile. Her facial features include a nose, lips, and a soft expression. Her hair is styled in an updo with wavy lines suggesting texture and volume. The woman is wearing a garment with a high collar, lightly sketched, with a hint of a necklace or brooch. The background of the sketch is plain. The sketch is on textured paper, with the name "FIDÈS DEVRIES" printed below the image.

artworks.title: Aigle Liant un Lièvre (An Eagle Pouncing on a Hare)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.description: This is an image of an eagle attacking a hare. The eagle has its wings partly outstretched, grasping the hare with its talons. The eagle looks fierce and majestic, while the hare is lying beneath it. The fur of the hare is detailed in texture. The background seems to depict a rocky or natural landscape with sketch-like lines. The drawing is done in a monochrome style with cross-hatching used for shading and depth.

artworks.title: Château on a Rise
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a castle with multiple turrets, viewed from a slightly elevated angle. The castle dominates the right side, with its towers against a backdrop of swirling clouds. The horizon is high, with trees and hills in the distance. The left side has lush foliage, including a large evergreen tree. The color palette is black and white, emphasizing the contrast between the castle and nature. Rolling hills can be seen in the distance.

artworks.title: Maquignons (Horse Dealers)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint in black on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a stable scene featuring horses and figures. The artwork depicts an outdoor setting with rough, sketched lines creating a sense of movement and texture. The scene shows two horses in the foreground being led or examined by figures standing under the eaves of a stable or rural structure. The horses are detailed with shadow and highlights to create depth. The background consists of textured and shaded areas representing the barn and sky, adding depth to the composition.

artworks.title: The Stone Breaker
artworks.medium: gillotype in black on wove paper; laid down
artworks.description: The image shows a boy in profile view from head to knee, holding a pewter bowl. He has short hair, soft facial features, and is wearing a short-sleeved shirt, pants, and suspenders. The background includes gardening tools, a basket, and vegetation, all within a textured, rustic landscape.

artworks.title: La Nuit & l'Amour (Night and Love)
artworks.medium: engraving in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two nude figures standing close to each other. One figure is in a reclining position while the other is leaning forward. They are both partly covered by a dark fabric that appears to be flowing around them. The figure on the right has short hair and distinct facial features, while the figure on the left has long, wavy hair. In the background, there is a crescent moon visible in the upper left corner.

artworks.title: Roundel Portrait of a Girl
artworks.medium: lithograph in green, black, and gold with hand-coloring on wove paper
artworks.dimensions:
overall size (circle): 14.9 cm (5 7/8 in.)
sheet: 29.4 x 20.5 cm (11 9/16 x 8 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a person's head and shoulders within a circular frame. The person has long, wavy hair, a pointed nose, and delicate lips. They wear a high-necked garment with frilled detailing. Surrounding them are detailed illustrations of hydrangea flowers with leaves. The background is plain with no other discernible features, and the circular image is on a beige background with inscriptions at the bottom corners.

artworks.title: Jalousie (Jealousy)
artworks.medium: hand-colored lithograph on wove paper
artworks.dimensions:
overall size (circle): 15 cm (5 7/8 in.)
sheet: 28.2 x 19.6 cm (11 1/8 x 7 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body depiction of a person with distinct facial features, framed by curly orange hair. They are draped in a brown shawl with a geometric pattern, gesturing towards it with one hand. Surrounding them are yellow roses with green leaves. In the background, there is a serene sky with white clouds and cypress trees, all contained within a circular frame.

artworks.title: L'Approche de l'Orage (The Storm's Approach)
artworks.artist: Jules-Ferdinand Jacquemart after Jan van de Cappelle
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is an etching depicting a view from water level across a body of water. The horizon is approximately in the middle of the composition, with several sailboats visible against the sky. On the left is a larger boat with a sail partially raised, accompanied by a smaller vessel with figures in it. The sky dominates the upper half with swirling clouds, suggesting an impending storm. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of gray and black, creating a moody atmosphere. In the distance, lighter patches on the horizon indicate other sailboats and potentially a distant shoreline or pier, enhancing the depth and scale of the view.

artworks.title: William Gladstone
artworks.medium: fumée engraving in black on tissue paper
artworks.description: The image features an elderly man in a suit with a bow tie. He has white hair and a serious expression. The background is plain.
